note: Employers whose public job postings come in as jobs (scripts/ingest/run.mjs postings). One line per employer: the name its board goes by, the company exactly as our data names it (and, in also, other companies we list under their own names whose plants the same board hires for), the hiring system and the board's token or address. An employer that is not read says why under leftOut. The employers are read in the order they are listed: boards that cost one request first, Workday's last and smallest first, so that a platform that turns the run away costs the fewest employers. scripts/ingest/postings/registry.mjs --check holds this file to its shape. Nothing behind SmartRecruiters' API is listed: its robots file disallows it. A Workday board that could not be read from the machine that verified it is left out, with its address, until a rehearsal has read it.

About 1,900 postings worldwide, 25 to a page: some 80 requests for the listing.
General Electric is not named: that row also holds plants that are not GE Aerospace's.

RTX has no plant under its own name: Raytheon, Collins Aerospace and Pratt & Whitney are recorded as parts of it, and their plants are used. Pratt & Whitney Engine Services is a row of its own.
